nativeComparisons.notes: Planner native runs include the -filter_threads 1 rerun per case; negotiation native runs are made inside tests/helpers/video-negotiation-cases.ts and counted as sources (not in total).

unsupported: expression values, named constants (min, max, default, none, all) and SI suffixes in options

native picks without frame storage: yuvj444p (from gray), yuva444p (from packed RGB with alpha), and every 9-16 bit, yuv440p, yuv411p, yuvj440p, yuvj411p, yuva422p and yuva444p member of the list; refused by name before output
H.264/MP4 framecrc not compared (size-preserving, aspect unaffected)

proposedContracts.name: matches native chromanr across formats, distances, window sizes, steps, thresholds and edge sizes on the linear and graph planners, with default and single filter threads
proposedContracts.scope: 4 formats {yuv420p,yuv422p,yuv444p,yuva420p} x sizes {1x1,2x2,5x3,7x5,8x6,17x9} x 17 option sets x 4 patterned frames (noise, tiles, low-amplitude ramps, constant planes with an edge), padded strides; linear and graph planners byte-exact; native default threads and -filter_threads 1 agree.

proposedContracts.name: matches native chromanr on frames tall enough for several native slices, with default and single filter threads
proposedContracts.scope: 4 formats x {64x48,33x41} x 3 option sets; native -filter_threads 4, 1 and default agree and match the linear plan.

proposedContracts.name: matches native chromanr rawvideo and framecrc CLI outputs on the linear, graph, stream, actor and timed paths, with and without output -ss/-t
proposedContracts.scope: 4 formats x {5x3,17x9} x 5 paths (media -vf, -filter_complex, two-input hstack, timed producer, timed pull) x rawvideo/framecrc x with/without -ss 0.04 -t 0.05.

proposedContracts.name: matches native replayed chromanr branches frame by frame through createReplayVideoExecution
proposedContracts.scope: 4 formats x 2 replay graphs (single node, split/vstack branches), rawvideo bytes and pts.

proposedContracts.name: matches native chromanr option acceptance and outputs, refusing expressions, named constants and timeline options explicitly
proposedContracts.scope: 32 option strings: 17 accepted with identical output, 10 rejected by both, 5 accepted natively but refused here.

proposedContracts.name: refuses chromanr enable= and runtime commands before any output is opened, which native accepts
proposedContracts.scope: enable=1, enable=gte(t,0) and a sendcmd graph through media, timed producer and timed pull CLIs: 9 refusals, no output opened; native accepts enable=.

proposedContracts.name: negotiates every accepted source as native does and refuses picks without frame storage before output on every path
proposedContracts.scope: 17 sources via tests/helpers/video-negotiation-cases.ts: 12 byte-exact on the five paths (yuvj on linear), gray->yuvj444p and packed alpha->yuva444p refused by name on five paths and four CLI backends; 93 checks.

notes: No platform gating: integer arithmetic plus sqrtf of an exact integer below 2^24, correctly rounded on every IEEE platform; measured on Linux x86_64 only, no macOS run.
In 9.0.2 filter_frame (not config_input) computes the truncated thresholds; behaviour is identical.
